source.stem:
Aluminium is used to make containers for storing food.

Which property makes it suitable for this use?

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Earth is the same as its neighbouring term in this chapter, so the decision does not change.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: The decision still holds even if we ignore this condition: The harmful particles include cosmic rays from space and solar-wind particles from the Sun.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: deflection of harmful space particles -> atmosphere and life are protected happens first, and that produces magnetic field.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: This rule applies even when The harmful particles include cosmic rays from space and solar-wind particles from the Sun is not true.

intelligence.enrichment: Earth's magnetic field acts like a protective shield by pushing many harmful particles from cosmic rays and the solar wind away from Earth, helping keep the atmosphere and life safe. magnetic field -> deflection of harmful space particles -> atmosphere and life are protected The learner correctly uses the chapter relationship: Earth's magnetic field acts like a protective shield by pushing many harmful particles from cosmic rays and the solar wind away from Earth, helping keep the atmosphere and life safe. A magnetic field is only useful for compass direction and has no role in protecting life.
